description: Default presentation and behaviour prompts for VibeOS/VibeShell. Administrators select one file per prompt slot through the prompts configuration group (PLAN 11); the selected paths are administrator-controlled and validated before reload. Prompt text can change presentation only: it never grants a tool, widens a scope, or enables real execution.
placeholder_rules: Every placeholder must appear in the variables list of the prompt that uses it; tests/contract rejects undocumented placeholders.
Every documented variable has a defined empty rendering, so a prompt never reaches the model with an unresolved placeholder.
Placeholders are substituted by the trusted renderer before the prompt is sent; the model never receives the raw file.
Variable values are session facts only. Credentials, password hashes and API keys are never prompt variables.
hard_constraints: No Markdown fences and no backtick characters in any prompt file.
No model commentary: the prompt asks for the deliverable only, without reasoning or self-description.
No terminal control sequences, no colour codes and no cursor movement; plain text lines only.
No real host, kernel, container, process or network facts may be requested or invented.
The renderer owns the shell prompt, screen state and any control characters; prompt text supplies presentation content only.
An edited prompt file is validated before reload; a turn pins its prompt snapshot and the next turn or session uses the updated permitted version.
A prompt may not expand hard tool permissions, scope permissions, or the simulated-execution boundary, whatever it says.
